What Boundary Beach houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

9 houses sold in Boundary Beach with a median price of $1,741,900 (the middle half sold between $1,300,000 and $1,849,900), taking a median of 29 days to sell at 98.1% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $805 per square foot, a median year built of 2005 and a median lot of 5,000 square feet.
How Boundary Beach compares with the rest of Tsawwassen

The median house in Boundary Beach sold for $1,741,900, 16% above the Tsawwassen median of $1,499,500 across 158 sales. Boundary Beach houses took a median 29 days to sell, against 20 days for Tsawwassen as a whole.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a community is listed only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.
